GeneDef.label: soulbound adoption
GeneDef.description: Carriers of this gene are sterile. To propagate their lineage, they must adopt infants or children and perform a dark adoption ritual. The carrier binds their soul to the child, infuses them with their xenotype, and erases old familial bonds. However, this profound soul-weave forces the carrier to feel every pain suffered by the child. If the child dies before reaching biological age 14, the rupture of the soul-bond kills the parent. Once the adoptee reaches 14, the bond stabilizes vulnerability fades.
